subject: Request: Executive sign-off to increase POC credit cap for Aureus Financial
messages:
From: George Patel <george.patel@aureusfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aureusfin.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — request to extend evaluation period

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the run-through today. The engineering team has started a wider integration test and we're seeing promising results, but the evaluation hit our PLG limits faster than expected because of batch replay and longer seq lengths. Procurement has asked whether Redwood can extend the pilot credits by another 500k tokens and push the POC window out two more weeks so we can finish performance validation and internal security review.

This is time-sensitive for our Q4 roadmap; without the extension it's unlikely we'll be able to include Redwood in the procurement shortlist. Can you advise on whether this is possible and what approvals are required?

Best,
George
VP, Engineering
Aureus Financial

Attachments: Aureus_MRP_project_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Redwood pilot — request to extend evaluation period

Laura / Monica — forwarding Aureus' ask. Short summary: their integration tests consumed the default PLG pilot cap in under a week (heavy batch replay + long contexts). They want an additional 500k tokens and two more weeks on the POC. Impact: bigger short-term credit exposure than standard PLG, but upside appears high — finance flagged an estimated ARR expansion opportunity of ~$180k if we win.

Request: can we get exec OK to grant a one-time, non-standard credit top-up + short extension? If we approve, I'd include a tight mutual action plan and a staged release of credits tied to milestones (smoke tests, data-handling signoff).

I've attached the SOW draft they sent and our suggested MAP. If useful, I can loop in Solutions for a short technical gating checklist.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---Original Message---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Redwood pilot — request to extend evaluation period

Aditya — I reviewed the numbers. A few points:

- Risk: 500k tokens is above our PLG ceiling for self-serve trials. We should gate the grant on measurable milestones and a procurement commitment timeline (e.g., they sign an LOI / submit an internal purchase request before we deliver the second tranche).
- Precedent: we've granted one-time top-ups for two similar mid-market banks this year, but both had signed a purchase intent or explicit procurement milestone.
- Legal/Finance: we need a shortexception approval and to note the credit as a marketing/engineering support concession for Q4. Rishi, please confirm if you need a formal dealdesk approval ticket or if an exec reply here suffices.

If everyone agrees, I'm OK with the staged approach: 200k tokens up-front, final 300k released on completion of the security checklist and an LOI from Aureus. Also limit the POC extension to 14 days.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Redwood pilot — request to extend evaluation period (EXEC APPROVAL)

All — after quick review with Finance and Legal, exec sign-off granted with the conditions below. Consider this thread the formal approval. Please copy Deal Desk and mark the ticket with DEAL-EXCEP-AUR-783.

Approval summary:
- One-time credit top-up: 500,000 tokens total
- Delivery schedule: 200,000 tokens released immediately after Aureus confirms the MAP and returns a countersigned LOI; additional 300,000 tokens released after completion of the security checklist and procurement confirmation (internal PR or PO).
- POC extension: 14 days from counter-signature of the LOI; no further extensions without C-suite approval.
- Monitoring: Solutions will share an hourly usage summary for the first 72 hours after top-up; Sales Ops to flag any anomalous consumption.
- Accounting treatment: classify as a marketing concession; cap recognized spend at the agreed token amount.

Aditya / Monica — you have my OK to proceed. Rishi will coordinate the dealdesk ticket and ensure the finance note is attached. Laura, add the exception to the month-end concessions report.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---Forwarded to external: prepare a short covering message and attach SOW-draft-v2.pdf and MAP link before sending. ---
